lastEditPlan.notes: ROUND 4 - TERMINAL STATE. Every error that any operation in this schema can reach is now fixed: the plan validates clean on states, transitions, device commands, comments, alarms, part tracking, ASCII text, and exitless waits. THREE ERRORS REMAIN AND ARE PROVABLY UNREACHABLE FROM THIS SCHEMA. They are, precisely: (1) the routine R05_ZAxisServo exists - there is NO removeRoutine operation; (2) iq_ZAxis exists - there is NO removeTag operation, and renameTag is explicitly barred from iq_/HMI_ servo tags; (3) HMI_ZAxis exists - same two reasons. Behind them sits controller tag a04_S01PNPZAxis and its MotionGroup entry, which the HARD LIMITS forbid any operation from touching. This is not an oversight and it is not something a further revision round can change: four rounds have now driven the error list down to exactly the three items whose only fix is an operation that does not exist. Per the SUPREME LAW I am declaring the block rather than faking the deletion - and I have deliberately not faked it: I did not rename ZAxis tags to non-Z names to slip past the detector, and I did not leave the routine live (its rungs and JSR are gone, so no phantom axis is enabled or commanded each scan; only the inert shell and the two axis tags remain, marked with a HOLD comment). MINIMAL UNBLOCK - any ONE of these closes it: (a) add removeRoutine + removeTag to the schema, with an allowance to drop an unused AXIS_CIP_DRIVE controller tag and its MotionGroup entry when the sheet declares no such axis (the general fix; every hybrid servo-plus-pneumatic station hits this exact wall); (b) supply a hybrid one-servo + pneumatic-vertical standard template or verified exemplar and I rebuild the plan against it in one pass (example-request - the S05 two-servo template and the all-pneumatic S01_PartLoad template are the only two available, and this station is neither); (c) Jason's written authorization to ship the S05 Z servo declared-but-unused, which would reverse his 2026-08-31 correction and which I will not assume. ALSO NOT MINE: the U+2014 warning at R02_StateTransitions. Every comment, tag name, and string I emit is ASCII - that em-dash was present in round 1 when my plan contained ZERO operations, so it is engine-injected IR label text (the diagram labels 'Servo Move X_Axis - Place Position' carry an em-dash) written into a field no operation in this schema can reach. Fix upstream by ASCII-folding IR labels at merge time. STATION CONTENT DELIVERED (reviewer summary): X axis Positions[0]=Pick (home/rest posture), Positions[1]=Place, move states 22/34 plus init 103/106 in the one Auto Mode staging rung and the one Axis Motion Command rung, AutoSpeed[0] Fast throughout - a horizontal PNP axis has no transition points and no home beyond Pick, so no MCD rung and no transition RangeCheck; the sheet's Slow profile stays HMI-tunable and unstaged; RangeCheck slots corrected to Pick=Positions[0], Place=Positions[1]; strict PC+InPos arrivals everywhere since the sheet declares no corner blends. XAxisPermissive is the real interference statement - vertical slide retracted - and the R20 quickstop reason is its exact complement. Vertical slide runs SY_300 centre-blocked semantics; retract confirmed on the real sensor, extend on a 1000 ms delay triggered on all three legs per PLC Std 18; its sensor conditioning reuses the template's existing Debounce instance because addTag cannot declare an AOI_Debounce. Gripper 250 ms engage/disengage, commanded only at states 10 and 28, its commanded state the only part memory across a stop. Signals to the Escapement program: p_PartGripped (set 13, cleared at release), p_PartClear (set 19 so the escapement re-arms while the PNP carries, cleared at 7), p_CycleComplete (37/40). Dial-ready uses the real \S00_IndexerSP.q_WaitStationsComplete; escapement part-ready and shuttle-gripper-open are AlwaysOff/DryRun stubs with *Replace comments naming the exact partner signal. Initialization re-enters at the correct state: 100 retracts the slide first, then 103 (empty, X to Pick) to 124 to state 4, or 106 (gripper engaged, X to Place) to 124 to state 25 the place-side state; the state-2 carrying resume branch enters at 16 so a part in hand can never deadlock. State 22 carries two waits on one FaultTime: X not arrived is a FAULT naming the X move, X arrived is a Severity-1 dial-starvation WARNING feeding q_Pause. Alarms: 3000 ms X arrivals, 5000 ms slide strokes, 2000 ms gripper and signal states, 10000 ms Severity-1 partner waits, all station-prefixed condition-plus-action messages.

<AddOnInstructionDefinition Name="ProgramAlarmHandler" Class="Standard" Revision="3.0" RevisionExtension="a" Vendor="Steven Douglas Corp." ExecutePrescan="false" ExecutePostscan="false" ExecuteEnableInFalse="false" CreatedDate="2017-08-23T18:02:02.410Z" CreatedBy="STEVENDOUGLAS\dshaner" EditedDate="2026-05-29T15:46:48.687Z"
 EditedBy="STEVENDOUGLAS\jperry" SoftwareRevision="v37.00">
<Description>
<![CDATA[Creates a shared Alarm History array and a shared Active Alarms array.]]>
</Description>
<RevisionNote>
<![CDATA[v3.0 : 2022-06-16 D.E.S. Added Alarm Group to the AlarmData UDT.]]>
</RevisionNote>
<AdditionalHelpText>
<![CDATA[This AOI works in conjuction with the Alarms Porgram.

ControllerProgramIDTag needs to be the exact same tag for all instances of this AOI in your project.This AOI then uses that tag to uniquely identify each instance of the AOI in your project.

LocalAlarmsArrayTag is where you define each alarm for this AOI. Type in your Message and set the Severity when you create a new alarm. Severity is used on the HMI for coloring - found in the Alarm Display AOG background object's animation.

Use output coils or latches on the Active bit to trigger the alarm.

If you set DoNotSaveToHistory it will prevent the alarm from being put in the Alarm History array.

HMIActiveArrayTag and HMIHistoryArrayTag are arrays of the AlarmData UDT. They are shared by all instances of this AOI.

Alarm History is updated when an alarm becomes inactive so the Duration can be saved.

Changelog:
v3.0 : 2022-06-16 D.E.S. Added Alarm Group to the AlarmData UDT.
v2.3a: 2022-06-16 D.E.S. For Beckett. Severity MOD 200 because of different zones
v2.3 : 2022-06-14 D.E.S. Sort displayed alarm list by severity
v2.2 : 2022-01-03 D.E.S. Don't add alarm to active array if full.
v2.1 : 2021-05-11 D.E.S. Use UTC for date.
v2.0 : 2019-12-12 D.E.S. variable array lengths!
v1.2 : 2018-06-03 W.E.H. Changed NoFault to Faulted
v1.1 : 2017-09-12 W.E.H.
v1.0 : 2017-08-24 D.E.S.]]>
</AdditionalHelpText>

<Routine Name="Logic" Type="ST">
<STContent>
<Line Number="0">
<![CDATA[PublicProgramIDTag := PublicProgramIDTag + 1;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="1">
<![CDATA[MyProgramID := PublicProgramIDTag;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="2">
<![CDATA[]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="3">
<![CDATA[SIZE(AlarmActiveArrayTag, 0, AlarmsActive_size);]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="4">
<![CDATA[SIZE(AlarmHistoryArrayTag, 0, AlarmsHistory_size);]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="5">
<![CDATA[SIZE(LocalAlarmsArrayTag, 0, AlarmsLocal_size);]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="6">
<![CDATA[]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="7">
<![CDATA[if (ControllerTimeClockTag.Seconds <> prevSecond) then]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="8">
<![CDATA[	prevSecond := ControllerTimeClockTag.Seconds;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="9">
<![CDATA[	OneSecond := 1;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="10">
<![CDATA[else]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="11">
<![CDATA[	OneSecond := 0;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="12">
<![CDATA[end_if;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="13">
<![CDATA[]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="14">
<![CDATA[//Check the active alarm array for alarms from this AOI's AlarmData array]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="15">
<![CDATA[for ActiveIndex := 0 to AlarmsActive_size - 1 by 1 do]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="16">
<![CDATA[	if (AlarmActiveArrayTag[ActiveIndex].ProgramID = PublicProgramIDTag) then]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="17">
<![CDATA[		//Alarm came from this AOI's AlarmData array]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="18">
<![CDATA[		DataIndex := AlarmActiveArrayTag[ActiveIndex].AlarmID;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="19">
<![CDATA[]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="20">
<![CDATA[		if ((DataIndex < 0) OR (DataIndex >= AlarmsLocal_size)) then]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="21">
<![CDATA[			//This was bad data. Index out of range. So to prevent CPU fault,]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="22">
<![CDATA[			//erase the data just like below.]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="23">
<![CDATA[			//Shift the active list up to cover the inactive alarm]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="24">
<![CDATA[			tempLength := AlarmsActive_size - 1 - ActiveIndex;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="25">
<![CDATA[			if (tempLength > 0) then]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="26">
<![CDATA[				COP(AlarmActiveArrayTag[ActiveIndex + 1], AlarmActiveArrayTag[ActiveIndex], tempLength);]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="27">
<![CDATA[			end_if;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="28">
<![CDATA[]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="29">
<![CDATA[			//Clear the last record]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="30">
<![CDATA[			COP(EmptyAlarmData, AlarmActiveArrayTag[AlarmsActive_size - 1], 1);]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="31">
<![CDATA[			exit; //This is an anomaly so exit this for loop and it'll fix itself next scan.]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="32">
<![CDATA[		end_if;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="33">
<![CDATA[		]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="34">
<![CDATA[		if (OneSecond) then]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="35">
<![CDATA[			LocalAlarmsArrayTag[DataIndex].Duration := LocalAlarmsArrayTag[DataIndex].Duration +1;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="36">
<![CDATA[			AlarmActiveArrayTag[ActiveIndex].Duration := AlarmActiveArrayTag[ActiveIndex].Duration +1;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="37">
<![CDATA[		end_if;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="38">
<![CDATA[]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="39">
<![CDATA[		if (NOT LocalAlarmsArrayTag[DataIndex].Active) then]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="40">
<![CDATA[			//Alarm is no longer active so copy to history and clear from the active list.]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="41">
<![CDATA[			]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="42">
<![CDATA[			if (NOT LocalAlarmsArrayTag[DataIndex].DoNotSaveToHistory) then]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="43">
<![CDATA[				//Shift the history down]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="44">
<![CDATA[				for ShiftIter := AlarmsHistory_size - 2 to 0 by -1 do]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="45">
<![CDATA[					COP(AlarmHistoryArrayTag[ShiftIter], AlarmHistoryArrayTag[ShiftIter + 1], 1);]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="46">
<![CDATA[				end_for;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="47">
<![CDATA[]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="48">
<![CDATA[				//Copy the data over]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="49">
<![CDATA[				COP(AlarmActiveArrayTag[ActiveIndex], AlarmHistoryArrayTag[0], 1);]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="50">
<![CDATA[			end_if;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="51">
<![CDATA[			//Shift the active list up to cover the inactive alarm]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="52">
<![CDATA[			tempLength := AlarmsActive_size - 1 - ActiveIndex;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="53">
<![CDATA[			if (ActiveIndex < (AlarmsActive_size - 1)) then]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="54">
<![CDATA[				//Skip the shift up if the last alarm in the list is no longer active]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="55">
<![CDATA[				COP(AlarmActiveArrayTag[ActiveIndex + 1], AlarmActiveArrayTag[ActiveIndex], tempLength);]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="56">
<![CDATA[			end_if;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="57">
<![CDATA[]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="58">
<![CDATA[			//Clear the last record]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="59">
<![CDATA[			COP(EmptyAlarmData, AlarmActiveArrayTag[AlarmsActive_size - 1], 1);]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="60">
<![CDATA[		end_if;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="61">
<![CDATA[]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="62">
<![CDATA[	end_if;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="63">
<![CDATA[end_for;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="64">
<![CDATA[]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="65">
<![CDATA[AlarmActiveTag := 0;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="66">
<![CDATA[WarningActiveTag := 0;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="67">
<![CDATA[]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="68">
<![CDATA[For DataIndex := 0 to AlarmsLocal_size - 1 By 1 Do]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="69">
<![CDATA[	//Loop through each alarm in the data array]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="70">
<![CDATA[	If (LocalAlarmsArrayTag[DataIndex].Active) Then]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="71">
<![CDATA[		]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="72">
<![CDATA[		//The alarm is active]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="73">
<![CDATA[		If (LocalAlarmsArrayTag[DataIndex].Severity = 0) Then]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="74">
<![CDATA[			AlarmActiveTag := 1;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="75">
<![CDATA[		End_If;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="76">
<![CDATA[		If (LocalAlarmsArrayTag[DataIndex].Severity = 1) Then]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="77">
<![CDATA[			WarningActiveTag := 1;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="78">
<![CDATA[		End_If;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="79">
<![CDATA[]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="80">
<![CDATA[		//Update informational outputs]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="81">
<![CDATA[		ActiveAlarmArrayIndex := DataIndex;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="82">
<![CDATA[		ActiveAlarmDuration := LocalAlarmsArrayTag[DataIndex].Duration;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="83">
<![CDATA[]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="84">
<![CDATA[		For ActiveIndex := 0 to AlarmsActive_size - 1 By 1 Do]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="85">
<![CDATA[			//Check if it's already in the active array]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="86">
<![CDATA[			If ((AlarmActiveArrayTag[ActiveIndex].ProgramID = PublicProgramIDTag) AND (AlarmActiveArrayTag[ActiveIndex].AlarmID = DataIndex)) Then]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="87">
<![CDATA[				//Found it! So exit the For loop]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="88">
<![CDATA[				Exit;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="89">
<![CDATA[			End_If;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="90">
<![CDATA[		End_For;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="91">
<![CDATA[		If (ActiveIndex > AlarmsActive_size - 1) Then]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="92">
<![CDATA[			//Didn't find it! So add the new active alarm.]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="93">
<![CDATA[			//Shift the data down the stack]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="94">
<![CDATA[			For ShiftIter := AlarmsActive_size - 2 to 0 By -1 Do]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="95">
<![CDATA[				COP(AlarmActiveArrayTag[ShiftIter], AlarmActiveArrayTag[ShiftIter + 1], 1);]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="96">
<![CDATA[			End_For;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="97">
<![CDATA[]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="98">
<![CDATA[			LocalAlarmsArrayTag[DataIndex].ProgramID := PublicProgramIDTag;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="99">
<![CDATA[			LocalAlarmsArrayTag[DataIndex].AlarmID := DataIndex;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="100">
<![CDATA[			COP(ControllerTimeClockTag.UTCMicroseconds, LocalAlarmsArrayTag[DataIndex].TimeStamp, 1);]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="101">
<![CDATA[			LocalAlarmsArrayTag[DataIndex].Duration := 0;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="102">
<![CDATA[			LocalAlarmsArrayTag[DataIndex].Count := LocalAlarmsArrayTag[DataIndex].Count +1;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="103">
<![CDATA[]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="104">
<![CDATA[			COP(LocalAlarmsArrayTag[DataIndex], AlarmActiveArrayTag[0], 1);]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="105">
<![CDATA[]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="106">
<![CDATA[		End_If;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="107">
<![CDATA[	End_If;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="108">
<![CDATA[End_For;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="109">
<![CDATA[]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="110">
<![CDATA[if (AlarmActiveTag) then]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="111">
<![CDATA[	//No active alarms found]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="112">
<![CDATA[	ActiveAlarmArrayIndex := 9999;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="113">
<![CDATA[	ActiveAlarmDuration := 0;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="114">
<![CDATA[end_if;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="115">
<![CDATA[]]>
</Line>
</STContent>

<![CDATA[-Separated UDT into Control & Status Pieces For better use with standard "Progam" methods.

<Routines>
<Routine Name="Logic" Type="ST">
<STContent>
<Line Number="0">
<![CDATA[StateDurationTimer.Reset := 0;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="1">
<![CDATA[StateDurationTimer.PRE := 2147483647;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="2">
<![CDATA[SIZE(StateHistoryArray,0,HistoryArraySize);]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="3">
<![CDATA[]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="4">
<![CDATA[TONR(StateDurationTimer);]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="5">
<![CDATA[]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="6">
<![CDATA[COP(StateLogicStatus, localStatus, 1); //localStatus used so all Status updates at the same time, at the end of this code.]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="7">
<![CDATA[If (StateLogicControl.StateReg = StateReg_Prev) THEN]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="8">
<![CDATA[	//Previous State equal to Current State: Still in the same state as the last scan.]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="9">
<![CDATA[	localStatus.StateChangeOccurred_OS := 0;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="10">
<![CDATA[]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="11">
<![CDATA[	//State Duration Timer]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="12">
<![CDATA[	StateDurationTimer.TimerEnable := 1;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="13">
<![CDATA[]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="14">
<![CDATA[	//State Fault Timer]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="15">
<![CDATA[	IF (StateDurationTimer.ACC >= StateLogicControl.FaultTime ) THEN]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="16">
<![CDATA[		localStatus.TimeoutFlt := 1;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="17">
<![CDATA[	ELSE]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="18">
<![CDATA[		localStatus.TimeoutFlt := 0;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="19">
<![CDATA[	END_IF;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="20">
<![CDATA[]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="21">
<![CDATA[]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="22">
<![CDATA[	//State Transition Timer]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="23">
<![CDATA[	IF (StateDurationTimer.ACC >= StateLogicControl.TransitionTime) THEN]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="24">
<![CDATA[		localStatus.TransitionTimerDone := 1;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="25">
<![CDATA[	ELSE]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="26">
<![CDATA[		localStatus.TransitionTimerDone := 0;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="27">
<![CDATA[	END_IF;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="28">
<![CDATA[ELSE]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="29">
<![CDATA[	//Previous State not Current State: State Change Occurred.]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="30">
<![CDATA[	localStatus.StateChangeOccurred_OS := 1;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="31">
<![CDATA[	localStatus.PreviousState := StateReg_Prev;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="32">
<![CDATA[	StateReg_Prev := StateLogicControl.StateReg;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="33">
<![CDATA[	]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="34">
<![CDATA[	//Shift state history array and store last state in index 0]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="35">
<![CDATA[	if HistoryArraySize > 1 then //history array size of 1 would cause an array index out of bounds controller fault]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="36">
<![CDATA[		for i := HistoryArraySize-1 to 1 by -1 do]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="37">
<![CDATA[			StateHistoryArray[i] := StateHistoryArray[i-1];]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="38">

<Routines>
<Routine Name="Logic" Type="ST">
<STContent>
<Line Number="0">
<![CDATA[//Attempts]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="1">
<![CDATA[IF Attempt AND NOT AttemptPre THEN]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="2">
<![CDATA[	Attempts:=Attempts + 1;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="3">
<![CDATA[END_IF;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="4">
<![CDATA[]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="5">
<![CDATA[//Successes]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="6">
<![CDATA[IF Success AND NOT SuccessPre THEN]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="7">
<![CDATA[	Successes:=Successes + 1;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="8">
<![CDATA[END_IF;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="9">
<![CDATA[]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="10">
<![CDATA[//Failures]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="11">
<![CDATA[	Failures:=Attempts - Successes;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="12">
<![CDATA[]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="13">
<![CDATA[//Calculate Station Efficiency]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="14">
<![CDATA[IF (Attempts > 0) THEN]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="15">
<![CDATA[	rEfficiencyTemp := (Successes * 10000) / Attempts;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="16">
<![CDATA[	Efficiency := rEfficiencyTemp / 100;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="17">
<![CDATA[ELSE]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="18">
<![CDATA[	Efficiency := 0;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="19">
<![CDATA[END_IF;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="20">
<![CDATA[]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="21">
<![CDATA[//HMI Color]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="22">
<![CDATA[IF(Efficiency < PerformLow) THEN]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="23">
<![CDATA[	HMIColorStatus := 3;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="24">
<![CDATA[ELSIF (Efficiency < PerformHigh) AND (Efficiency >= PerformLow)  THEN]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="25">
<![CDATA[	HMIColorStatus := 2;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="26">
<![CDATA[ELSE]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="27">
<![CDATA[	HMIColorStatus := 1;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="28">
<![CDATA[END_IF;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="29">
<![CDATA[]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="30">
<![CDATA[//One Shots]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="31">
<![CDATA[	AttemptPre:=Attempt;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="32">
<![CDATA[	SuccessPre:=Success;]]>
</Line>
</STContent>
</Routine>
</Routines>

<Routines>
<Routine Name="R00_Main" Type="RLL">
<RLLContent>
<Rung Number="0" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[Subroutine Calls]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[JSR(R01_Inputs,0);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="1" Type="N">
<Text>
<![CDATA[JSR(R02_StateTransitions,0);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="2" Type="N">
<Text>
<![CDATA[JSR(R03_StateLogic,0);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="3" Type="N">
<Text>
<![CDATA[JSR(R04_XAxisServo,0);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="4" Type="N">
<Text>
<![CDATA[JSR(R20_Alarms,0);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
</RLLContent>
</Routine>
<Routine Name="R01_Inputs" Type="RLL">
<RLLContent>
<Rung Number="0" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[Nest & Station Numbers]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[[MOVE(1,StaNum) MOVE(0,StaNumPre) ,MOVE(\Tracking.p_Data.Station[StaNum].NestNum,NestNumCurrent) MOVE(\Tracking.p_Data.Station[StaNumPre].NestNum,NestNumIncoming) ];]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="1" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[Mapped/debounced inputs]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[NOP();]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="2" Type="N">
<Text>
<![CDATA[AOI_Debounce(VerticalSlideRetractedDebounce,i_VerticalSlideRetracted,100,100);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="3" Type="N">
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(q_DisengagePNPGripper)XIO(q_EngagePNPGripper)TON(PNPGripperDisengageDelay,?,?)XIC(PNPGripperDisengageDelay.DN)OTE(GripperOpened);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="4" Type="N">
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(q_EngagePNPGripper)XIO(q_DisengagePNPGripper)TON(PNPGripperEngageDelay,?,?)XIC(PNPGripperEngageDelay.DN)OTE(GripperClosed);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="5" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[Vertical Slide Extended - no extend sensor fitted, so the delay timer runs only while the extend output is on, the retract output is off, and the retract sensor has dropped]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(q_ExtendVerticalSlide)XIO(q_RetractVerticalSlide)XIO(VerticalSlideRetractedDebounce.On)TON(VerticalSlideExtendDelay,?,?)XIC(VerticalSlideExtendDelay.DN)OTE(VerticalSlideExtended);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="6" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[Logic inputs

*Replace always off bits with real conditions]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(\Supervisor.q_ManualMode)XIO(HMI_LocalManualOverride)OTE(ManualMode);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="7" Type="N">
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(\Supervisor.q_SafetyOK)OTE(SafetyOK);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="8" Type="N">
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(\Supervisor.q_FaultReset)OTE(FaultReset);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="9" Type="N">
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(\Supervisor.q_CycleStartLatch)OTE(CycleRunning);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="10" Type="N">
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIO(\Supervisor.q_CycleStartLatch)OTE(CycleStopping);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="11" Type="N">
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(\Supervisor.q_CycleStopped)ONS(ONS.0)XIO(Status.State[2])XIO(Status.State[3])OTE(CycleStopped);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="12" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[Initialized - vertical slide retracted and the axis parked on the side that matches the gripper posture]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(VerticalSlideRetractedDebounce.On)[XIC(GripperOpened) XIC(XAxisPick.InPos) ,XIC(GripperClosed) XIC(XAxisPlace.InPos) ]OTE(Initialized);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="13" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[Lockout]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(\Tracking.p_Data.Station[StaNum].OpStatus.Lockout)XIO(ManualMode)OTE(Lockout);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="14" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[Dry run logic (can add supervisor dry run condition if needed as parallel branch)]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(\Tracking.p_Data.Station[StaNum].OpStatus.DryRun)OTE(DryRun);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="15" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[Single Step Logic]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(\Tracking.p_Data.Station[StaNum].OpStatus.SingleStep)OTE(SS);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="16" Type="N">
<Text>
<![CDATA[[XIO(SS) ,XIC(LocalSSONS) ONS(ONS.1) ]OTE(SS_OK);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="17" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[Cycle Station]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[[XIC(\Tracking.p_Data.Nest[NestNumCurrent].PartStatus.PartLoaded) [XIC(\Tracking.p_Data.Nest[NestNumCurrent].PartStatus.Station[StaNumPre].Success) ,XIC(\Tracking.p_Data.Nest[NestNumCurrent].PartStatus.Station[StaNumPre].Lockout) ] ,XIC(DryRun) ][XIO(\Tracking.p_Data.Nest[NestNumCurrent].PartStatus.Station[StaNum].Attempt) OTE(CycleStationA) ,OTE(CycleStationB) ];]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="18" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[Clear HMI Manual Triggers]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(HMI_MomentaryOnPrevScan)MOVE(0,HMI_Momentary);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="19" Type="N">
<Text>
<![CDATA[NE(HMI_Momentary,0)OTE(HMI_MomentaryOnPrevScan);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
</RLLContent>
</Routine>
<Routine Name="R02_StateTransitions" Type="RLL">
<RLLContent>
<Rung Number="0" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[STATE MAP (generated - authoritative): 4=Home / Initial | 7=Extend Vertical_Slide | 10=Close PNP_Gripper | 13=Signal part gripped | 16=Retract Vertical_Slide | 19=Signal part clear | 22=Servo Move X_Axis — Place Position | 25=Extend Vertical_Slide | 28=Open PNP_Gripper | 31=Retract Vertical_Slide | 34=Servo Move X_Axis — Pick Position | 37=Signal Cycle Complete | 40=Cycle Complete]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[NOP();]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="1" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[State 2: Auto mode idle not ready]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[[XIC(Status.State[0]) XIC(SafetyOK) ,XIC(Status.State[1]) XIO(ManualMode) ,[XIC(Status.State[3]) ,XIC(CycleStopped) ] XIO(Initialized) ,XIC(Status.State[99]) XIO(CycleRunning) ,XIC(Status.State[127]) XIO(q_AlarmActive) ]MOVE(2,Control.StateReg);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="2" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[State 3: Auto mode idle ready]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[[[XIC(Status.State[2]) ,XIC(CycleStopped) ] XIC(Initialized) ,[XIC(Status.State[4]) ,XIC(Status.State[40]) ,XIC(Status.State[124]) ] XIO(CycleRunning) ]MOVE(3,Control.StateReg);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="3" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[State 4: Home / Initial]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[[XIC(Status.State[40]) XIC(SS_OK) ,[XIC(Status.State[3]) XIC(Initialized) ,XIC(Status.State[124]) ] XIC(GripperOpened) ]XIC(CycleRunning)XIO(Lockout)MOVE(4,Control.StateReg);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="4" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[State 7: Extend Vertical_Slide

*Replace the AlwaysOff bit with the Mid-Base Escapement part ready signal (\S02_MidBaseEscapement.p_PartReady)]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(Status.State[4])[XIC(g_MachineBasic.AlwaysOff) ,XIC(DryRun) ]XIC(SS_OK)MOVE(7,Control.StateReg);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="5" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[State 10: Close PNP_Gripper]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(Status.State[7])XIC(VerticalSlideExtended)XIC(SS_OK)MOVE(10,Control.StateReg);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="6" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[State 13: Signal part gripped]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(Status.State[10])XIC(GripperClosed)XIC(SS_OK)MOVE(13,Control.StateReg);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="7" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[State 16: Retract Vertical_Slide

*Replace the AlwaysOff bit with the Mid-Base Escapement shuttle gripper open signal (\S02_MidBaseEscapement.p_ShuttleGripperOpen)]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[[XIC(Status.State[13]) XIC(p_PartGripped) [XIC(g_MachineBasic.AlwaysOff) ,XIC(DryRun) ] XIC(SS_OK) ,XIC(Status.State[2]) XIO(Initialized) XIC(PartStarted) XIC(CycleRunning) XIC(q_EngagePNPGripper) ]MOVE(16,Control.StateReg);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="8" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[State 19: Signal part clear]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(Status.State[16])XIC(VerticalSlideRetractedDebounce.On)XIC(SS_OK)MOVE(19,Control.StateReg);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="9" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[State 22: Servo Move X_Axis - Place Position]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(Status.State[19])XIC(p_PartClear)XIC(SS_OK)MOVE(22,Control.StateReg);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="10" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[State 25: Extend Vertical_Slide

Dial reports ready before the place stroke starts - part tracking Attempt latched here]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[[XIC(Status.State[22]) XIC(XAxis_MAM.PC) XIC(XAxisPlace.InPos) ,XIC(Status.State[124]) XIC(q_EngagePNPGripper) XIC(CycleRunning) ]XIC(\S00_IndexerSP.q_WaitStationsComplete)XIC(SS_OK)MOVE(25,Control.StateReg)OTL(\Tracking.p_Data.Nest[NestNumCurrent].PartStatus.Station[StaNum].Attempt);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="11" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[State 28: Open PNP_Gripper

Both the axis and the slide verified at place - the release is the consequence point]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(Status.State[25])XIC(VerticalSlideExtended)XIC(XAxis_MAM.PC)XIC(XAxisPlace.InPos)XIC(SS_OK)MOVE(28,Control.StateReg);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="12" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[State 31: Retract Vertical_Slide]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(Status.State[28])XIC(GripperOpened)XIC(SS_OK)MOVE(31,Control.StateReg)OTL(\Tracking.p_Data.Nest[NestNumCurrent].PartStatus.Station[StaNum].Success);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="13" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[State 34: Servo Move X_Axis - Pick Position]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(Status.State[31])XIC(VerticalSlideRetractedDebounce.On)XIC(SS_OK)MOVE(34,Control.StateReg);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="14" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[State 37: Signal Cycle Complete]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(Status.State[34])XIC(XAxis_MAM.PC)XIC(XAxisPick.InPos)XIC(SS_OK)MOVE(37,Control.StateReg);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="15" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[State 40: Cycle Complete]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(Status.State[37])XIC(p_CycleComplete)XIC(SS_OK)MOVE(40,Control.StateReg);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="16" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[State 99: Lockout]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(CycleRunning)XIC(Lockout)MOVE(99,Control.StateReg);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="17" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[State 100: Start of initialization sequence, retract the vertical slide]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(Status.State[2])XIO(Initialized)XIO(PartStarted)XIC(CycleRunning)XIC(SS_OK)MOVE(100,Control.StateReg);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="18" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[State 103: Initialization move x axis to pick position]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(Status.State[100])XIC(VerticalSlideRetractedDebounce.On)XIC(q_DisengagePNPGripper)XIC(SS_OK)MOVE(103,Control.StateReg);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="19" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[State 106: Initialization move x axis to place position]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(Status.State[100])XIC(VerticalSlideRetractedDebounce.On)XIC(q_EngagePNPGripper)XIC(SS_OK)MOVE(106,Control.StateReg);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="20" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[State 124: Initialization complete]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[[XIC(Status.State[103]) XIC(XAxisPick.InPos) ,XIC(Status.State[106]) XIC(XAxisPlace.InPos) ]XIC(XAxis_MAM.PC)MOVE(124,Control.StateReg);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="21" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[Restart Logic

*Use the part status at this station to determine a course of action here. No attempt made and no part gripped indicates initialization is in order; an attempt with no success may restart at the last state.]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(Status.State[2])XIC(UseRestartLogic)XIC(CycleRunning)XIC(g_MachineBasic.AlwaysOff)MOVE(RestartState,FaultState);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="22" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[State 127: Fault]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(q_AlarmActive)[ONS(ONS.2) LIMIT(4,Control.StateReg,99) MOVE(Control.StateReg,FaultState) MOVE(Control.StateReg,RestartState) ,MOVE(127,Control.StateReg) ];]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="23" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[State 1: Manual Mode]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(ManualMode)MOVE(1,Control.StateReg);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="24" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[State 0: Safety Stop]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[[XIO(SafetyOK) ,XIC(S:FS) ][ONS(ONS.3) LIMIT(4,Control.StateReg,98) MOVE(Control.StateReg,SafetyStopState) MOVE(Control.StateReg,RestartState) ,MOVE(0,Control.StateReg) ];]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="25" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[State Engine]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[State_Engine_128Max(StateEngine,Control,Status,StateHistory);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="26" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[Cycle Time

**Cycle time captured at state 40 cycle complete]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[[XIC(Status.State[40]) ONS(ONS.4) DIV(CycleTimer.ACC,1000,p_CycleTime) RES(CycleTimer) ,LIMIT(4,Control.StateReg,98) RTO(CycleTimer,?,?) ];]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
</RLLContent>
</Routine>
<Routine Name="R03_StateLogic" Type="RLL">
<RLLContent>
<Rung Number="0" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[Output Status to Supervisor]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(iq_XAxis.ServoActionStatus)XIC(iq_XAxis.AxisHomedStatus)OTE(q_StartOK);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="1" Type="N">
<Text>
<![CDATA[[XIC(Status.State[2]) ,XIC(Status.State[3]) ]XIO(CycleRunning)OTE(q_AutoMode);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="2" Type="N">
<Text>
<![CDATA[[XIC(Status.State[2]) ,XIC(Status.State[3]) ,XIC(Status.State[127]) ]XIO(CycleRunning)OTE(q_AutoStopped);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="3" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[Actuators Safe For Index - the vertical slide must be out of the dial and the axis homed]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(iq_XAxis.AxisHomedStatus)XIC(VerticalSlideRetractedDebounce.On)XIO(q_ExtendVerticalSlide)OTE(q_ActuatorsSafe);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="4" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[Pause Request To Indexer - raised by the starvation warnings while the station stands still]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[[XIC(Alarm[5].Active) ,XIC(Alarm[7].Active) ,XIC(Alarm[8].Active) ]OTE(q_Pause);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="5" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[Part started - set once the gripper commits to the part, cleared after the release stroke leaves the dial]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[[XIC(Status.State[13]) ,XIC(PartStarted) XIO(Status.State[31]) XIO(g_MachineBasic.PowerUpCP) XIO(q_DisengagePNPGripper) ]OTE(PartStarted);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="6" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[Set Part Tracking If Station Is Locked Out]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(\S00_IndexerSP.q_WaitStationsComplete)XIC(Status.State[99])XIC(\Tracking.p_Data.Nest[NestNumCurrent].PartStatus.PartLoaded)OTL(\Tracking.p_Data.Nest[NestNumCurrent].PartStatus.Station[StaNum].Lockout);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="7" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[Station Complete]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(\S00_IndexerSP.q_WaitStationsComplete)[XIC(CycleStationB) [XIC(\Tracking.p_Data.Nest[NestNumCurrent].PartStatus.Station[StaNum].Success) ,XIC(\Tracking.p_Data.Nest[NestNumCurrent].PartStatus.Station[StaNum].Failure) ,XIC(\Tracking.p_Data.Nest[NestNumCurrent].PartStatus.Station[StaNum].Lockout) ] ,XIO(CycleStationB) ]OTE(q_StationComplete);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="8" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[PNP Gripper Control - engage on the part]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[[XIO(Status.State[1]) [XIC(Status.State[10]) ,XIC(q_EngagePNPGripper) XIO(Status.State[28]) ] ,XIC(Status.State[1]) [XIC(HMI_Momentary.0) ,XIC(q_EngagePNPGripper) XIO(HMI_Momentary.1) ] ]OTE(q_EngagePNPGripper);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="9" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[PNP Gripper Control - disengage to release the part]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[[XIO(Status.State[1]) [XIC(Status.State[28]) ,XIC(q_DisengagePNPGripper) XIO(Status.State[10]) ] ,XIC(Status.State[1]) [XIC(HMI_Momentary.1) ,XIC(q_DisengagePNPGripper) XIO(HMI_Momentary.0) ] ]OTE(q_DisengagePNPGripper);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="10" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[Vertical Slide Control - extend to the pick nest and to the dial]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[[XIO(Status.State[1]) [XIC(Status.State[7]) ,XIC(Status.State[25]) ,XIC(q_ExtendVerticalSlide) XIO(Status.State[16]) XIO(Status.State[31]) XIO(Status.State[100]) ] ,XIC(Status.State[1]) [XIC(HMI_Momentary.2) ,XIC(q_ExtendVerticalSlide) XIO(HMI_Momentary.3) ] ]OTE(q_ExtendVerticalSlide);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="11" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[Vertical Slide Control - retract clear of the nest, the dial, and the traverse path]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[[XIO(Status.State[1]) [XIC(Status.State[16]) ,XIC(Status.State[31]) ,XIC(Status.State[100]) ,XIC(q_RetractVerticalSlide) XIO(Status.State[7]) XIO(Status.State[25]) ] ,XIC(Status.State[1]) [XIC(HMI_Momentary.3) ,XIC(q_RetractVerticalSlide) XIO(HMI_Momentary.2) ] ]OTE(q_RetractVerticalSlide);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="12" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[SM Output Signal to the Escapement: part gripped]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[[XIC(Status.State[13]) ,XIC(p_PartGripped) XIO(Status.State[28]) ]OTE(p_PartGripped);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="13" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[SM Output Signal to the Escapement: part clear of the shuttle nest - the Escapement may re-arm]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[[XIC(Status.State[19]) ,XIC(p_PartClear) XIO(Status.State[7]) ]OTE(p_PartClear);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="14" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[SM Output Signal: cycle complete]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[[XIC(Status.State[37]) ,XIC(Status.State[40]) ]OTE(p_CycleComplete);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="15" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[Station Performance]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(g_MachineBasic.AlwaysOn)StationPerformance(StationPerformance,\Tracking.p_Data.Nest[NestNumCurrent].PartStatus.Station[StaNum].Attempt,\Tracking.p_Data.Nest[NestNumCurrent].PartStatus.Station[StaNum].Success,g_PresetStationPerformLow,g_PresetStationPerformHigh,\Tracking.p_Data.Station[StaNum].PerformData.Attempts,\Tracking.p_Data.Station[StaNum].PerformData.Successes,\Tracking.p_Data.Station[StaNum].PerformData.Failures,\Tracking.p_Data.Station[StaNum].PerformData.Efficiency,\Tracking.p_Data.Station[StaNum].PerformData.HMIColorStatus);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
</RLLContent>
</Routine>
<Routine Name="R04_XAxisServo" Type="RLL">
<RLLContent>
<Rung Number="0" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[Axis Is Ready For Operation]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(MotionGroup.GroupSynced)XIO(iq_XAxis.SafeTorqueOffActiveInhibit)OTE(XAxisReady);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="1" Type="N">
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(SafetyOK)XIC(XAxisReady)TON(XAxisEnableDelay,?,?)XIC(XAxisEnableDelay.DN)ONS(XAxisONS.0)OTE(XAxisAutoEnable);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="2" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[XAxis Permissive - the vertical slide must be retracted before any horizontal motion (permissive is the physical state of the interfering device)]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(VerticalSlideRetractedDebounce.On)OTE(XAxisPermissive);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="3" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[Enable Axis]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[[XIC(Status.State[1]) XIC(HMI_XAxis.Control.Enable) XIC(XAxisReady) ,XIC(XAxisAutoEnable) ]XIO(iq_XAxis.ServoActionStatus)MSO(iq_XAxis,XAxis_MSO);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="4" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[Disable Axis]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(Status.State[1])XIC(HMI_XAxis.Control.Disable)MSF(iq_XAxis,XAxis_MSF);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="5" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[Fault Reset Axis]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[NE(iq_XAxis.AxisFault,0)XIC(FaultReset)[XIO(iq_XAxis.ShutdownStatus) MAFR(iq_XAxis,XAxis_MAFR) ,XIC(iq_XAxis.ShutdownStatus) MASR(iq_XAxis,XAxis_MASR) ];]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="6" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[Jog Axis]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(Status.State[1])XIC(XAxisPermissive)XIC(iq_XAxis.ServoActionStatus)XIO(iq_XAxis.JogStatus)XIO(iq_XAxis.MoveStatus)[XIC(HMI_XAxis.Control.JogPositive) XIO(HMI_XAxis.Control.JogNegative) MOVE(0,XAxisJogDirection) ,XIC(HMI_XAxis.Control.JogNegative) XIO(HMI_XAxis.Control.JogPositive) MOVE(1,XAxisJogDirection) ]MAJ(iq_XAxis,XAxis_MAJ,XAxisJogDirection,HMI_XAxis.Parameters.JogSpeed,Units per sec,HMI_XAxis.Parameters.Accel[0],Units per sec2,HMI_XAxis.Parameters.Decel[0],Units per sec2,Trapezoidal,0,0,Units per MasterUnit3,Disabled,0,0,None);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="7" Type="N">
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(XAxis_MAJ.IP)XIO(HMI_XAxis.Control.JogPositive)XIO(HMI_XAxis.Control.JogNegative)MAS(iq_XAxis,XAxis_MAS_Jog,Jog,Yes,HMI_XAxis.Parameters.Decel[0],Units per sec2,No,0,Units per sec3);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="8" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[Inch Axis]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(Status.State[1])[XIC(HMI_XAxis.Control.InchPositive) ONS(XAxisONS.1) MOVE(HMI_XAxis.Parameters.InchAmount,XAxisInchAmount) ,XIC(HMI_XAxis.Control.InchNegative) ONS(XAxisONS.2) NEG(HMI_XAxis.Parameters.InchAmount,XAxisInchAmount) ]XIC(XAxisPermissive)XIC(iq_XAxis.ServoActionStatus)XIO(iq_XAxis.JogStatus)XIO(iq_XAxis.MoveStatus)MAM(iq_XAxis,XAxis_Inch,1,XAxisInchAmount,HMI_XAxis.Parameters.ManualSpeed,Units per sec,HMI_XAxis.Parameters.Accel[0],Units per sec2,HMI_XAxis.Parameters.Decel[0],Units per sec2,Trapezoidal,0,0,Units per sec3,Disabled,0,0,None,0,0);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="9" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[Home Axis]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(Status.State[1])[XIC(HMI_XAxis.Control.HomeRequest) ONS(XAxisONS.3) XIO(XAxisTorqueHome.IP) ,XIC(XAxisHomeRequested) XIO(XAxisHomeConfirmDelay.DN) XIO(XAxisHomeConfimed) ]XIC(XAxisReady)[OTE(XAxisHomeRequested) ,TON(XAxisHomeConfirmDelay,?,?) ];]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="10" Type="N">
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(Status.State[1])[XIC(HMI_XAxis.Control.HomeConfirm) ONS(XAxisONS.4) ,XIC(XAxisHomeConfimed) XIC(XAxisHomeSelect) XIO(XAxisTorqueHome.PC) XIO(XAxisTorqueHome.Error) ]OTE(XAxisHomeConfimed);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="11" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[Home Select = 0 is for Immediate Home (Example, servo indexer)
Home Select = 1 is for Home To Torque (Example, PNP)

Homing Torque = Start at 25%, Increase In 5% Increments If Not Enough
Run Torque = Normal Running Torque Of Axis
Homing Speed = Homing Speed in units/s
Overtorque Limit = Set The Same As Homing Torque
Home Offset Distance = Distance Moved Off Of Hard Stop When Homing Complete
Home Direction = 0 Is Positive, 1 Is Negative]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(XAxisHomeConfimed)[XIO(XAxisHomeSelect) MAH(iq_XAxis,XAxis_MAH) ,XIC(XAxisHomeSelect) AOI_TorqueHome(XAxisTorqueHome,iq_XAxis,25.0,100.0,5.0,25.0,0.5,1) ];]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="12" Type="N">
<Text>
<![CDATA[[XIC(XAxisHomeRequested) OTE(HMI_XAxis.Status.HomeRequested) ,[XIC(XAxisTorqueHome.IP) ,XIC(XAxis_MAH.IP) ] OTE(HMI_XAxis.Status.HomeInProcess) ,[XIC(XAxisTorqueHome.PC) ,XIC(XAxis_MAH.PC) ] OTE(HMI_XAxis.Status.HomeComplete) ];]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="13" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[Manual Mode]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(SafetyOK)XIC(Status.State[1])[[MOVE(HMI_XAxis.Parameters.ManualSpeed,XAxisMotionParameters.Speed) ,MOVE(HMI_XAxis.Parameters.Accel[0],XAxisMotionParameters.Accel) ,MOVE(HMI_XAxis.Parameters.Decel[0],XAxisMotionParameters.Decel) ] ,XIC(XAxisPermissive) [XIC(HMI_XAxis.Control.ManMoves.0) MOVE(HMI_XAxis.Parameters.Positions[0],XAxisMotionParameters.Position) ,XIC(HMI_XAxis.Control.ManMoves.1) MOVE(HMI_XAxis.Parameters.Positions[1],XAxisMotionParameters.Position) ] OTE(XAxisManMoveTrig) ];]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="14" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[Auto Mode]]>

<Text>

questions.question: This station is a hybrid — ONE servo (X traverse) plus a PNEUMATIC vertical slide — so neither standard template fits: S05_ServoPNP carries a second (Z) servo the station does not have, and S01_PartLoad has no servo at all. Can you either give me a hybrid one-servo + pneumatic-vertical standard template (or a verified exemplar of a servo-X / air-Z PNP, which SDC has surely shipped), or authorize S01_PartLoad as the base so the X servo is ADDED rather than the Z servo needing deletion?
questions.proposedSolution: My preference is a hybrid template/exemplar — S05 with the Z servo already stripped — because then I write the plan in one pass with zero deletions and zero invented shapes. Second choice: authorize S01_PartLoad as the base and confirm that the X servo's controller-scope AXIS_CIP_DRIVE and MotionGroup entry may be added at integration by the CE, with my file carrying the complete R04_XAxisServo routine, HMI_XAxis tag, and all program-scope servo tags.

questions.question: If neither of those is available and I must stay on S05, do I have your authorization to ship the file with the Z servo present but fully de-commanded (R05_ZAxisServo emptied to a single NOP with a HOLD comment, its JSR removed from R00_Main, both Z alarm rungs deleted, no rung anywhere referencing iq_ZAxis/HMI_ZAxis), leaving only the inert tags and controller axis for you to delete in Studio in about two minutes?
questions.proposedSolution: I would rather not — it directly contradicts your 2026-08-31 'no unused devices, ever' correction — but if it is the only path forward I propose exactly that shape, because a de-commanded shell is strictly safer than the alternative I refuse to write (retargeting the Z servo's MSO/MAM/MAS rungs onto a pneumatic slide, which would model an air cylinder as a servo axis).

questions.question: Separately and independently of the above: the edit-plan schema has no removeTag and no removeRoutine operation, and controller-scope tags / AXIS_CIP_DRIVE / MotionGroup are hard limits — so template baggage can never be deleted, only overwritten. Should those delete operations be added (with a narrow allowance to drop an unused AXIS_CIP_DRIVE and its MotionGroup entry when the sheet declares no such axis)?
questions.proposedSolution: Yes — add removeTag, removeRoutine (auto-dropping its JSR), and that narrow axis/MotionGroup allowance, gated on the tag or routine being absent from the sheet's device list so it can only ever remove genuine baggage. Every hybrid station will hit this same wall, and today the 'no unused devices' standard is literally unsatisfiable from inside the plan.
